subtitle: "Every released chapter, with its PDF"
description: "Read QMSBR chapters online or download the reviewed PDF."
---

Read online for the linked, searchable version; download the PDF for printing
and annotation. Both come from the same source file.

To add a chapter: drop its `.qmd` and `.pdf` into `part-one/` or `part-two/`,
add it to `render:` and the sidebar in `_quarto.yml`, and add one row here.

## Still being written

Part One continues through interaction and moderation, generalized linear
models, prediction, and a capstone on credible regression claims. Part Two
continues into structural equation models. Those chapters appear here when they
are finished — there are no placeholder links.
